as_of_content:
[[File:Boost newsfeed banner.jpg|thumb]]
Introduced in v.2.0, Boosts give a temporary boost to all Bots' stats for a limited time.

''Boosts are consumable items that offer a variety of different effects or advantages for a limited time. There are a variety of different effects that range from increasing a bot’s health to increasing the amount of experience you earn to aid your growth as a Commander. There are also certain boosts that only work in certain modes, like a boost that can reverse the effects of mods in the spotlight mission.''

''While you can apply multiple boosts to your account, you will not be able to activate more than ONE boost of each kind at a time. For example, if you activate a Tier 1 Damage Boost, you will not be able to add another one on top of it. If you choose to activate a new Tier 1 Damage Boost (or one of a higher tier), it will replace the previous one.''

''Some boosts will be available for purchase in the store, while others will only be attainable as rewards throughout the game.''
